notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v0.3.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496408/56cdb0c7de3f59185750487b7558980c118737f3.png"][/img]This update is a big one! Here's the breakdown:[/p][p][/p][h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Ray tracing graphics supported[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting improvements[/p][/*][*][p]5 campaign stages added[/p][/*][*][p]Party members now gain battle XP to raise levels[/p][list][*][p]Duplicate copies can still be fused (worth 10 xp each)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Skills can now be toggled even after a unit has moved[/p][/*][*][p]Skirmish zones unlock as you progress through the story[/p][/*][*][p]Figures from other zones may appear in skirmishes[/p][/*][*][p]You can hover over the gacha pool to see the stats on your current collectables[/p][/*][*][p]Numbered party positions are displayed in the party editor[/p][/*][*][p]Save games are now backed up and properly included in Steam cloud[/p][/*][*][p]New skills: Headpat, Jump, Hover, Heavyweight[/p][/*][*][p]New figures: Bat, Chroll, Mantis, Moverbot, Guard, Allie[/p][/*][/list][h3]Less Exciting Updates[/h3][list][*][p]"Sharke" has been renamed to "Sharpe," opening possibilities for a shark character in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]"Spike" renamed to "Frenzy," because someone else is now named "Spike"[/p][/*][*][p]"Reflex" renamed to "Counter Stance" to better reflect the passive trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]"Overflow" renamed to "Seconds!"[/p][/*][*][p]"Perma-spike" renamed to "Spike"[/p][/*][*][p]Dargon's skill has been changed from Iron Ball to Heavyweight[/p][/*][*][p]Wolf's skill has been changed from Spike to Jump[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet now imparts full kinetic energy to targets, especially on glancing blows. I think this is actually a more exciting update, why did I list it here?[/p][/*][/list][h3]Commentary[/h3][p]Thanks to a series of "I just gotta put in one more thing...!" It's been 1.5 months since the last update, But with this, I think the demo is pretty much complete! Now I just need to buckle down and finish the campaign. Granted, I'll still update the demo with any bug fixes and quality of life improvements, but I hope that with this you'll have a more detailed glimpse of the full game's vision.[/p][p]Alright, back into the slog I go![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v0.2.3
notes.content: [h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Text chat available! (Shortcut: 'T')[/p][/*][*][p]Added player panel where you can edit your name/color and kick players[/p][/*][*][p]Added friend bonus! Each additional player in your party gives you +5% rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced economy so there are no more fractional coins. Player bank has been scaled 10x to match the new values.[/p][/*][*][p]"Damage Dealt" is now "Base Bounty" in the rewards panel[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked UI navigation for stability (better gamepad support!)[/p][/*][*][p]Account switcher updated to be keyboard/gamepad navigable[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fix for invisible figure previews in inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for gamepad unable to interact with Allie[/p][/*][/list][h3]Commentary[/h3][p]Okay, I think the features are in a solid spot now to support basic multiplayer necessities, and even gamepad support is up to 96% by my estimates. Now to hunker down on content and campaign. Watch me go! *[i]runs into spikes[/i]*[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.1
notes.content: [p]Fix for a recent bug where changes to the party in single player would not apply 😜[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v0.2.0
notes.content: [h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Polished a lot of the multiplayer experience[/p][list][*][p]Session can now be configured from the starting menu, supporting offline and passwords. No longer can strangers drop into your game at all times![/p][/*][*][p]Make sure players are all synced before starting a match or advancing special cutscenes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changes to Options:[/p][list][*][p]Added Options menu to New Account screen (so you can turn down the music)[/p][/*][*][p]Added slider to adjust volume when game is in the background[/p][/*][*][p]Added VSync, Dynamic Resolution, and more graphics options[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Skills:[/p][list][*][p]New skills: "Dart": lob a dart that deals 1 damage, and the first 5 point skill "Perma-Spike": always spiky[/p][/*][*][p]Reassigned character skills to better reflect their fantasy:[/p][list][*][p]Slime: Regen => Frail[/p][/*][*][p]Skeleton: Armor => Dart[/p][/*][*][p]Castella: Stun => Armor[/p][/*][*][p]Wolf: Stun => Perma-Spike[/p][/*][*][p]Shroom: Blind => Stun[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new campaign stage "Lock it Down" (Renamed "Shifting Gears" to "Modus Operandi")[/p][/*][*][p]Button sounds. Click click click![/p][/*][*][p]Equip slotted units directly from other loadouts[/p][/*][*][p]\[Collection] button under your party allows you to browse your collection without shuffling your party.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim Gear tip size increased by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled Ray Tracing and Megalights tech[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled Steam Cloud saves[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Extra figures don't appear in remote client prize pool anymore. Sorry![/p][/*][*][p]Fix for different levels being generated between client and host[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiplayer party resetting configuration whenever you modified a loadout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crates & barrels being double-spawned on top of each other on the remote client[/p][/*][/list][h3]Commentary[/h3][p]I've put a lot of work into stabilizing the multiplayer experience in this patch, but there's still so much remaining to do (like chat, and kicking). But more urgent than that is trying to get this iteration out there based on the feedback I've gathered from streams and comments! Hopefully 0.2.0 rectifies some poor designs in the demo. Thanks for playing, and keep that feedback coming![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v0.1.8
notes.content: [h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]The Aim Gear is now the default aiming mode (left-right adjusts directions, up-down adjusts power). The tutorials have been updated to reflect this.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim mode is remembered between play sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic Sensitivity has been replaced with the Aim Clamp (default key: Space), allowing you to manually dial the sensitivity for the current shot. Moving the cursor while the clamp is up will adjust it (0 = complete freedom, 100 = near total lock-down)[/p][/*][*][p]Added mouse & gamepad sensitivity sliders in the Input options[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio option for "Clicky Aim Gear" so you can aim in silence[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced default music volume[/p][/*][*][p]New players are no longer asked if they want to skip the tutorial [/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]"Mega Breakshot!!" (which is awarded for breaking an enemy with 3 or more HP in one move) will no longer proc on enemies whose HP is 2 out of 3.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Commentary[/h3][p]I spent a day trying to make dynamic aim sensitivity work, but it was too obfuscated and the situations too ambiguous for a one-size-fits-all solution, so it's manual now. I hope to make a tutorial stage explaining how it works in the next patch.[/p][p]And speaking of tutorials: as much as it pains me to remove the option to skip it, I watched a new player say No to the tutorial and then proceed to have the worst unguided introduction to the game. Who would have thought that if I gave the choice between survival training or wilderness that someone might choose wrong? [/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo v0.1.7
notes.content:
[h3]Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Added "Aim Sensitivity" slider under Input Options[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Dynamic Sensitivity" checkbox under Gameplay Options (defaults to Off)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with skill descriptions running off the bottom of the screen
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Commentary[/h3][p]I've heard feedback that the controls don't feel right! Thanks, that was important for me to hear. I had tried to do something "clever" by guessing if you were trying to make a delicate shot based on how fast you were aiming, so if the game thought you were crawling, it made sure you were [i]really slow[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Turns out it's one of the worst parts of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]So I'm sealing this feature behind an opt-in checkbox while I look for a better solution to deal with those times when you're bouncing between three corners of the stage. Until then, I really appreciate everyone who took the time to try it out and let me know![/p]
